criteria: Identifies eukaryotic and prokaryotic features and links structures to functions correctly

Describes aseptic technique and interprets zones of inhibition or colony growth data

criteria: Two complete, timed 1 hour 45 minute, 100-mark papers at the learner's tier (Paper 1: topics 4.1-4.4; Paper 2: topics 4.5-4.7)
At least one required-practical-based question answered correctly in each paper
Performance holds up across topics under mixed order, including Biology-only depth content
Extended answers use precise scientific vocabulary, and calculations show working and units
exam_rubric.pass_threshold: Foundation tier: performance consistent with grade 4-5 across full papers. Higher tier: performance consistent with grade 6-7. AQA sets exact grade boundaries per series rather than a fixed mark table.
